main_section_html:
Stock import

Columns supported in CSV/paste: product, form, batch, expiry, hsn, gst, mrp, rate, upp, packs, units. (Also supports optional: generic, strength, unit). If dosage form is not specified in a row, the Default Dosage Form selected above is used. Automatically creates both Item and Medication entries.

Download a template

#ProductDosage FormBatchExpiryGSTMRPRatePer packPacksUnitsCheck

Importing sets each batch to the quantity in the file. A batch that already exists is corrected to that quantity, and new products are created in both Item and Medication masters.
